title: War of the Spark: Ravnica – Rallying the Reluctant

entities.name: Rat
entities.description: A small Gateless thief and eavesdropper who follows Kaya and Teyo and still mourns Hekara.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: The Orzhov guildmaster and planeswalker, who fails to win her guild's full support but gains an honor guard and Bilagru's enforcers.

entities.name: Teyo Verada
entities.description: A young planeswalker and Shieldmage acolyte who stays by Rat and Kaya.

entities.name: Madame Blaise
entities.description: Kaya's chief servitor at Orzhova.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: The matriarch of the Orzhov's leading oligarch family, who stays in her quarters.

entities.name: Armin Morov
entities.description: A very old human pontiff and Orzhov Triumvirate member who evades Kaya's call to fight.

entities.name: Slavomir Zoltan
entities.description: A handsome vampire tithe-master and Triumvirate member who avoids the cost of war.

entities.name: Maladola
entities.description: An angel, former Boros member and Orzhov chief warrior-executioner who offers an honor guard but defers to the others.

entities.name: Bilagru
entities.description: A twelve-foot armored giant, chief enforcer of the Church Militant, who commits his enforcers and military to protect Orzhov interests against the Eternals.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: Matriarch Karlov's assistant and Kaya's friend, who cannot be found.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: The Izzet guildmaster who proposes Operation Desperation and the reconstitution of the Guildpact.

entities.name: Maree
entities.description: Zarek's goblin second-in-command who says even ninety percent of the guilds is not enough.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker and former Living Guildpact who leads the summit and lays out the problems.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who rallies the crowd with his vow to retake Ravnica using Blackblade.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker who reminds Gideon of the Oath.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A psychometrist thief and planeswalker whom Rat has been studying and who attempts to touch Kiora's bident.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: A planeswalker in a gold-filigreed dress whom Dack flirts with.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A planeswalker who counters a minotaur's mockery.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A planeswalker from Amonkhet who volunteers to go back through the portal and warns Bolas is never sated.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker with a shiny bident.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A planeswalker who scoffs at the plan to use the portal.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A sarcastic demon planeswalker whom most avoid, who mocks Jace and Gideon.

entities.name: Miss Longbow
entities.description: A planeswalker with a longbow, from Skalla, who insists that Bolas is never sated.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: The planeswalker controlling the Eternals for Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker invading Ravnica and harvesting planeswalker Sparks.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: The Azorius guildmaster who has been working with Bolas and guards the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The former Azorius guildmaster who was turned to stone and is now a statue.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: The Golgari guildmaster, absent, who turned Isperia to stone and worked with Bolas.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: The Rakdos emissary who died, for which Rakdos blames the summit leaders.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: The Gruul guildmaster and planeswalker harvested by an Eternal after trying to join Bolas.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon guildmaster who is dead and left a final stratagem.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: The Simic leader who angrily argues planeswalkers brought Bolas.

entities.name: Vannifar
entities.description: The Simic guildmaster.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The Boros guildmaster who agrees that Ravnica must not share Amonkhet's fate.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: An Azorius officer who disavowed Baan and urges unity.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The Rakdos guildmaster who declined to send representatives.

entities.name: Triumvirate
entities.description: Three Orzhov leaders (Morov, Zoltan, Maladola) who assumed power after the Obzedat's fall.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The former Orzhov rulers assassinated by Kaya.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The guild Kaya leads, whose leaders resist her call.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A guild that attends the summit in force.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild that attends the summit in force.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A guild that attends the summit in force.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A league of planeswalkers, led here by Jace and Gideon, sworn to the Oath to stay and fight.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Bolas's undead soldiers and God-Eternals marching on the Senate.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: A guild that sends no representative.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: A leaderless guild absent from the summit.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A leaderless guild absent from the summit.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: A guild that did not attend.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild that retreated behind its borders.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild whose Senate House hosts the summit.

entities.name: Cathedral Opulent
entities.description: The Orzhov guildhall where Kaya meets the Triumvirate.

entities.name: Senate House
entities.description: The Azorius building hosting the planeswalker and guild summit.

entities.name: The Beacon
entities.description: The Izzet device luring planeswalkers to Ravnica, guarded in Beacon Tower.

entities.name: The Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact that traps planeswalkers on Ravnica, in a New Prahv tower guarded by Baan.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: Gideon's black broadsword, said to have slain one Elder Dragon.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: The portal from Amonkhet that lets an endless Eternal army reach Ravnica.

entities.name: Operation Desperation
entities.description: Niv-Mizzet's final stratagem requiring cooperation from all ten guilds.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The founding pact binding Ravnica's ten guilds, which Zarek wants reconstituted.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Samut's home plane, desolated by Bolas.

entities.name: Skalla
entities.description: The archer's home plane, completely destroyed by Bolas.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane under siege.

events.summary: Kaya reaches Orzhova and asks her chief servitor to rally the Orzhov against Bolas.
events.quote: In an attempt to rally the Orzhov to fight Bolas and his Eternals

events.summary: Kaya meets the Orzhov Triumvirate, who refuse to commit forces and only offer an honor guard to the Senate.
events.quote: If our new guildmaster would lead the charge, I'm sure the church executioners would be pleased to provide her with an honor guard

events.summary: Chief Enforcer Bilagru offers his enforcers and the Syndicate's military to protect Orzhov investments from the Eternals, and Kaya threatens to forgive all debts.
events.quote: I can render all debt collection moot, by forgiving every single debt this instant.

events.summary: At the Senate House summit, Rat notes that most guilds are absent, and Rakdos blames the leaders for Hekara's death.
events.quote: Lord Rakdos blamed Master Zarek, Mistress Kaya, Miss Lavinia, and Mistress Vraska

events.summary: Rat learns Domri Rade is dead after his Spark was harvested and that Niv-Mizzet is dead.
events.quote: Turns out he was a Planeswalker and got his Spark harvested by an Eternal.

events.summary: Zarek and Maree discuss Operation Desperation, requiring all ten guilds.
events.quote: you'll need cooperation from ten of ten guilds. There can be no exceptions.

events.summary: Rat overhears Jace defend Vraska's act against Isperia and thinks he may be in love with her; Gideon and Jace affirm their friendship.
Jace lays out five problems: the Beacon, the Immortal Sun, the Planar Bridge, Liliana Vess, and Bolas himself.
events.quote: We face a number of problems. Five to be exact.

events.summary: Jace identifies Liliana Vess as controlling the Eternals for Bolas and says she must be stopped forever, to Gideon's silence.
events.quote: Liliana Vess. She's clearly controlling the Eternals for Bolas.

events.summary: Gideon adds a sixth problem, protecting ordinary Ravnicans, and Zarek adds a seventh, reconstituting the Guildpact.
events.quote: We need to reconstitute the Guildpact by uniting all ten guilds.

events.summary: Attendees argue about surrender or hiding, and Vorel blames planeswalkers while the archer and Samut insist Bolas is never sated.
events.quote: There is literally nothing left of my world, Skalla, thanks to him.

events.summary: Gideon, encouraged by Ajani's reminder of the Oath, vows to retake Ravnica with Blackblade and the crowd gathers around him.
events.quote: With it, I hereby vow to take back this world. Who's with me?

events.summary: An Izzet goblin warns that a God-Eternal with an army is approaching; Jace calls for volunteers for six missions while Zarek asks Kaya to help with Operation Desperation.
events.quote: one a' them God-Eternals approaches, at the head of a small army of those undead creepies!
